data.title: Rate Limit
data.tagline: A service limit on requests, tokens, or concurrent tasks within a period of time
data.learningOutcome: You can respond to a 429 by queuing work, lowering concurrency, and waiting as instructed.
data.description: After a limit is reached, a request may wait, slow down, or return 429. The exact limits vary by service, model, and account, so distinguish request, token, and concurrency limits.

learning.assumes: You have seen a queue, a retry-later message, or a request failure.
learning.outcome: You can respond to a 429 by queuing work, lowering concurrency, and waiting as instructed.

explanation.title: Enter a queue
explanation.text: The product queues work and runs only some tasks at once; that controls concurrency.

explanation.title: A limit returns 429
explanation.text: 429 commonly means there are too many requests and an immediate retry is not appropriate.

explanation.title: Wait as instructed
explanation.text: Follow `Retry-After` when supplied, or use documented backoff while keeping the queue controlled.

data.boundary: Unlimited immediate retries after 429 keep hitting the limit and can make queues and failures worse.

lessonPractice.title: Rapid clicks on Regenerate hit a rate limit. What should the UI do next?

options.label: Stop immediate retries, explain when to retry, and prevent duplicate submission
options.feedback: Correct. A limit is temporary refusal; clear waiting guidance and duplicate prevention avoid making it worse.

options.label: Retry automatically every 100ms until it succeeds
options.feedback: Fast retries keep triggering the limit and can affect other requests.

options.label: Hide the error and let people click more
options.feedback: People need to know the action did not complete and when it can be retried.

data.agentPrompt: When Regenerate is rate-limited, read any available wait information, disable duplicate clicks, and show when the next attempt is allowed; re-enable it then. Simulate one 429 and confirm only one request is sent, the wait is visible, and retry works after it ends.
